q1_rc_planning.question: Is executed A/B evidence strong enough for RC planning?
q1_rc_planning.answer: YES — Executed evidence (not just design) shows Factory advantage on a matched task. RC planning is reasonable. RC is not release.

q2_ab1_needed.question: Is AB-1 needed?
q2_ab1_needed.answer: RECOMMENDED but not blocking RC — A second executed trial on a different project type would strengthen generalizability. But one executed trial + 17/18 READY criteria is sufficient for RC consideration.

q3_next.question: Recommended next?
q3_next.answer: RELEASE-CANDIDATE-0 (RC package only) if user accepts remaining blockers. Or FACTORY-AB-1 (second executed trial) for stronger evidence. Or USER-REVIEW-0.
options: RELEASE-CANDIDATE-0 — RC package only (user must accept remaining blockers)
FACTORY-AB-1 — Second executed matched trial on different project type
